title: Work panel: after the Urgent strip opens an item's details, the view row's first press re-selects instead of closing
outcome: Pressing an expanded Work row (aria-expanded=true) always closes its details, whether the details were opened from the row or from the Urgent strip, and a strip press closes details the view row opened; toggle-to-close is keyed on the selected item (and label group), not on which trigger opened it.
acceptance: Work panel: after the Urgent strip opens an item's details, the view row's first press re-selects instead of closing is done
